definitions.gloss: naturalness; how natural something looks, sounds, or feels
definitions.explanation: The quality or degree of being natural and unforced, describing how authentic or organic something appears, sounds, or feels.

examples.japanese: {自然|しぜん}さが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
この{翻訳|ほんやく}は{自然|しぜん}さに{欠|か}ける。
{演技|えんぎ}の{自然|しぜん}さを{出|だ}すために、{何度|なんど}も{練習|れんしゅう}した。
examples.english: I practiced many times to bring out naturalness in my acting.

notes:
Formed by adding the suffix さ (degree, -ness) to {自然|しぜん} (natural). Expresses the quality or degree of being natural — how authentic, unforced, or organic something appears. Frequently used in discussions of language, translation, acting, appearance, and design.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自然|しぜん}さがある: to have naturalness
- {自然|しぜん}さに{欠|か}ける: to lack naturalness
- {自然|しぜん}さを{出|だ}す: to bring out naturalness
- {自然|しぜん}さを{保|たも}つ: to maintain naturalness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ナチュラルさ: naturalness — loanword version; often used in beauty and fashion contexts
- {自然体|しぜんたい}: natural posture/attitude — being oneself without pretense
- {不自然|ふしぜん}さ: unnaturalness — the opposite quality
